text:
maria (PM): Quick async standup for ship-week checkpoints. TL;DR: summarizing blocking items + priority asks.
- What I did: finalized the rollout gating spec and updated the QA matrix.
- Blockers: need engineering signoff on fallback behavior for region routing (spec section 3.2).
- Today: finalize rollback playbook + coordinate infra for KMS perms. @aj can you confirm ETA on the signoff?

aj (eng): Saw the spec and left a few inline comments. I can take full signoff by EOD after I push the PR with the minor clarifications.
Blocker on my side: private deployment tests are failing due to KMS permission errors — opened a ticket with infra-sre and pinned logs in the ticket.
I'll also finish the feature-flag wiring for the soft-launch toggle after the PR. PR: #3421 (WIP).

noah (eng): I can review #3421 today — aiming for review in the next 2 hours.
Heads-up: the kv-cache integration test is flaky, reproducing intermittently (created issue #128 with steps). That might affect perf numbers for the canary.
Working on the canary script for routing fallback; will push a small helper:
```
# canary toggle example
./canary --route routing.fallback=soft --duration 30m
```

sarah (design): Updated the Console screenshots for the onboarding flow and added a short note in the docs about the soft-launch UX. No blockers from design side. I've added the embedding validation case to the QA matrix per the test plan.

ci-bot: Build passed for commit abc123 on main. Deploy to staging scheduled at 18:00 UTC. (artifact: gitlab/redwood/inference/1234)

maria (PM): Quick prioritization call: if infra doesn't unblock KMS today, can we proceed with a soft-launch region filter instead of full rollouts? Please react with :+1: (soft-launch) or :-1: (hold) and leave a short note if you vote hold.

aj (eng): :+1: I'll add the soft-launch flag and ensure the rollback hook is present.

noah (eng): :+1: Agree. If infra still blocked, set knob `routing.fallback=soft` in canary. I'll include a health-check gating step.

sarah (design): +1 from UX. I'll prepare a small banner for users in the soft-launch region.

maria (PM): Thanks — two quick action items: 1) @aj add the fallback toggle + rollback steps to the PR, 2) @noah include the kv-cache repro in the canary notes so QA knows what to look for.

aj (eng): On it. Also pinging QA to validate embeddings batch behavior with quantized models — tagging in the test plan.

sarah (design): Added the QA checklist item for embeddings + quantization.

maria (PM): Great. I'll consolidate updates and post a final ship checklist here before staging deploy. If anything becomes blocking, I'll escalate to the oncall. Thanks everyone!
